content:
“Home run with each hit!”

**Heavy Hitter** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *CAMP Revamp* update.

Melee weapons deal more power attack damage.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 3 | Melee weapons deal +25% power attack damage. (No Power Tools) | 00520BD4 | 

- Before update 62, the perk provided +10%/+15%/20% damage to two-handed melee weapons and was named "Master Slugger."
